sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
jina: Preservation and enforcement of freedom of debate and proceedings
maudhui: Parliament may enact a law making provision to enable the courts and the law to preserve and enforce the freedom of opinion, debate and proceedings in the National Assembly which is guaranteed by this Constitution under Article 100.
